fixed: Changing a new dance's type to English (ECD) now starts its formation on Duple minor instead of keeping a contra formation such as Improper in the English list, and changing a new English dance to contra starts it on Improper when its formation isn't one contra offers. Changing a saved dance's type between contra and English keeps what its formation says, as Convert English dances does: Improper becomes Duple minor with Starts improper on, a triplet becomes a three-couple longways set, and back again.
